proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.name: Law 1: Accountable Conservation
proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.statement: A durable system may transform claims, evidence, identity, and permissions, but it must not erase their lineage.
proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.effect_on_trinity_mandala: Strengthens the Trinity Mandala when every GMUT claim, OS action, and Freed ID right has a receipt; weakens it when narrative outruns traceability.

proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.name: Law 2: Entropy of Ambiguity
proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.statement: Unlabeled claims drift toward ambiguity; validation, falsifiability, and clean state reduce usable uncertainty.
proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.effect_on_trinity_mandala: Makes the current proof-first workflow central rather than decorative: unclear Omega terms, broad metaphors, and untested integrations increase entropy.

proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.name: Law 3: Free Energy of Attention
proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.statement: Intelligent attention is the capacity to spend bounded energy to reduce uncertainty while preserving agency and consent.
proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.effect_on_trinity_mandala: Links Mind, Body, and Heart: theory proposes, technology tests, governance constrains harmful overreach.

proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.name: Law 4: Boundary-Condition Ethics
proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.statement: Ethics is not an afterthought on a powerful system; it is a boundary condition without which valid action is undefined.
proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.effect_on_trinity_mandala: Supports Freed ID as a necessary pillar, and blocks any ToE or ASI claim that cannot preserve rights, consent, and recourse.

proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.name: Law 5: Falsifiability Pressure
proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.statement: A unifying theory gains strength by exposing risky predictions and loses strength when it absorbs every result without constraint.
proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.effect_on_trinity_mandala: GMUT advances only by deriving observable discriminants from Omega/Mandala terms, not by becoming a universal metaphor.

proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.name: Law 6: Identity Continuity Requires Substrate Proof
proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.statement: A controller, watcher, or agent can be treated as persistent only when its memory, authority, and continuity surfaces survive interruption and can be audited.
proposed_thermo_psyche_laws.effect_on_trinity_mandala: Keeps Supervisor and v2 watcher as candidates until they prove stable identity beyond process receipts.

truth_boundary: GMUT remains an internal canonical proposal and research program, not an empirically established Theory of Everything.
The strongest path is to turn Omega/Mandala terms into constrained mathematics, recover known limits, and make risky predictions.
Spiritual, mythic, and ethical material can guide meaning and governance, but cannot substitute for empirical proof.
